name: changelog-hub
description: Changelog & Product Updates Widget — MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix frontend
